C1.worst_defect: The H1 'Point of sale for Vendure' and its pitch never say who this is for or who should pick something else. There is no comparison with alternatives, so a sceptic has to work out the fit alone.

C2.worst_defect: No page names a maintainer, company or support channel beyond a GitHub link. No real store is shown using it. The only plugin releases are 0.1.0 (2026-10-01) and 0.2.0/0.3.0 (both 2026-10-06), nothing in the six weeks since. The 'simulated store in your browser' demo can refund and take a customer note, but plugin 0.3.0 can do neither.
C2.where: home.desktop footer ('MIT licensed. Built with TallyUI.'); changelog.desktop.01

C3.worst_defect: A self-hoster goes through nine quick-start steps and must also patch a known defect by hand: the plugin's own 'New POS till key' role lacks ReadOrder on 0.3.0. Refunds on a real store need two Admin API GraphQL calls (settleRefund). There is no screenshot of the till's 'Sign in to Vendure' screen.

C4.worst_defect: Troubleshooting falls into protocol jargon: 'The store must advertise order.create v4 and register v1; plugin 0.3.0 advertises order.create 1–5'. Leftover code names (TallyPosPlugin, /tally/v1/commands) appear in the docs and need explaining.

C5.worst_defect: none found. Consistent docs chrome, clear hierarchy, a good hero till screenshot and a dark mode that holds up. Only the quick start's length makes the desktop page a long scroll.

C6.worst_defect: The phone quick start runs to about 10,640 px of continuous steps, with code blocks and a stacked tax table. It works, but it is a long scroll with no collapsing.

C7.worst_defect: none found that matters. Lighthouse mobile scores 98/100/100/100, JSON-LD is present on home and docs, and llms.txt, llms-full.txt, sitemap and robots all return 200. The only console error is the expected 404 resource error on not-found.

overall_worst.defect: The site never says who builds or supports VendurePOS, or whether any real store runs it. The analytics go to ph.wcpos.com with no explanation, and there has been no plugin release since 0.3.0 on 2026-10-06. A sceptic comparing it with Shopify POS or Square cannot judge the bus factor.
overall_worst.fix: Add a short 'Who maintains this' block on home and Overview. Name the maintainer or organisation and how it relates to WCPOS/TallyUI, link a support or issues channel, give the release cadence, and list any pilot stores (or say plainly that there are none yet).
